text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [PAGER] Sev 2 - Zephyr dedicated pool (zephyr-corp) - model degradation detected at 2026-02-21T23:12:03Z. 5xx rate -> 12%, p95 latency 1.8s -> 4.3s. Automatic mitigation candidate: fallback to safe variant or pin to v2. Please triage.

maya: ack, I'm on it. paging jordan and liam.

jordan (oncall): oncall here, looking. can you add quick summary of affected endpoints?

maya: affected routes: `/v1/generate` and `/v1/chat` for tenant `zephyr-corp` on dedicated pool `dp-zephyr-03`. Errors are timeouts from model process `gpt-xl-2026-beta` and occasional `524` proxy from sidecar.

liam: seeing elevated `kv_cache_miss` and `quant_lb_failure` in logs for that pool. looks like the quantized path is thrashing after recent release.

sam (SE): tagging in — Zephyr is in VPC + dedicated. they have strict isolation, so cross-tenant fallback isn't allowed. we need a tenant-scoped policy: either pin to a stable non-quantized variant or route to a safe reduced-capacity replica in the same pool.

maya: agree. propose immediate mitigation: apply tenant override to pin model to `gpt-xl-2025-stable` for zephyr-corp and disable quantized fastpath for that tenant. that should stop 5xx and lower latencies, albeit at slightly higher tokens cost.

rebecca (AM): I'll notify the customer CSM but need approval from security for override since it touches model selection in VPC.

ops-bot: audit note created: `audit/1772048123/zephyr-override` (link: https://console.redwood.internal/audit/1772048123).

jordan (oncall): can we run this as a controlled override with a canary first (5% traffic), then ramp? want to avoid sudden capacity spike on other hosts.

maya: yes. plan: 1) create override: pin tenant to `gpt-xl-2025-stable` with traffic split 95% -> original, 5% -> pinned. 2) disable quantized path for tenant. 3) monitor 5xx and p95 for 10 minutes, then 50/50, then 100% if stable.

liam: I can push the override via admin API. command:```bash
# tenant override (dry-run)
curl -X POST "https://internal-admin.redwood/api/v1/overrides" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"tenant":"zephyr-corp","route":"/v1/generate","pin_model":"gpt-xl-2025-stable","traffic_split":{"pinned":0.05}}'
```

maya: +1. please include `disable_quant_fastpath=true` in the same request so the runtime will avoid the qpath for that tenant.

liam: pushing now (non-prod dry-run passed).

ops-bot: action started by liam at 2026-02-21T23:18:10Z.

liam: override applied: `override_id=ovr-20260221-77`. initial canary set to 5%.

maya: monitoring telemetry...

(2m pass)

maya: early signal good — 5xx dropped from 12% -> 1.6% for the canary slice, overall p95 for tenant down to 2.1s.

jordan (oncall): scaling note: the pin increases CPU usage on model hosts; ops team, please watch GPU mem and scheduler queues.

ops-bot: autoscaling policy triggered additional host `dp-zephyr-03b` at 2026-02-21T23:22:03Z.

rebecca (AM): updated Zephyr CSM (cc: Zephyr SRE) — telling them we are running a canary pin to a stable model, will escalate if anything changes.

sam (SE): good to confirm customer-visible downgrade: fewer hallucinations? any change in output quality?

maya: quick eval on sample prompt set: outputs are consistent with pre-release baseline. small increase in latency but acceptable.

liam: ramping to 50% now via admin. command snippet:```json
{"override_id":"ovr-20260221-77","traffic_split":{"pinned":0.5}}
```

ops-bot: override ramp logged.

(5m pass)

maya: metrics stable for 5m at 50% — 5xx ~0.9%, p95 ~1.9s. recommending full switch.

jordan (oncall): ok to go 100% but keep rollback playbook ready. who signs off? rebecca?

rebecca (AM): signing off to proceed. I'll keep customer on standby.

liam: rolling to 100% now.

ops-bot: override completed 100% at 2026-02-21T23:31:47Z. `override_id=ovr-20260221-77` state=active.

maya: verifying final state... all good, 5xx < 0.5% and p95 1.7s.

sam (SE): we should capture this as a tenant-specific emergency policy: add a guarded fallback for zephyr-corp to pin to `gpt-xl-2025-stable` automatically if 5xx > 5% for 3m. also include a cooldown so we don't flip-flop.

jordan (oncall): filing follow-up ticket for automation: `INF-7428` with proposed thresholds and cooldown.

rebecca (AM): customer notified, no SLA breach expected. I'll schedule a post-incident call tomorrow with Zephyr SRE and their CSM.

maya: notes for postmortem: probable root cause = quantized fastpath regression after `runtime-v2.11` (deployed earlier today). affected only dedicated pools with that runtime + quantized model artifact. remediation: revert runtime or update qpath guards.

liam: I archived detailed logs to the incident bundle: `s3://incidents/1772048123/bundle.zip`. contains stack traces and model-side logs.

ops-bot: incident state -> mitigated. closing pager.

maya: thanks team. follow-ups: 1) `INF-7428` automation ticket, 2) rollback plan or patch for qpath, 3) customer postmortem w/ Zephyr. I'll own the tech follow-ups.

rebecca (AM): I'll own customer comms and PM scheduling.

sam (SE): will draft recommended tenant policy templates (pin + cooldown + canary ramp).

jordan (oncall): handing back to regular rotation. good work. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: [CLOSED] Incident 1772048123 marked mitigated at 2026-02-21T23:34:20Z. Audit: `audit/1772048123`
